project.title: Microbial community in a full-scale petrochemical wastewater treatment plant
project.description: A full-scale petrochemical wastewater treatment plant employed the anoxic/oxic (A/O) process to treat acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene(ABS) wastewater. Samples were taken from the fourth oxic tank.
